<!-- PROTOTYPE v2 — fact sheet. Throwaway. -->

::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: The single place to ask for help with any BigPicture service. The Service Desk is the first line of support: it answers what it can, and passes the rest to the team that runs the service. You keep one contact throughout.

Who it's for
: Everyone: data contributors, data users, partners and anyone interested in BigPicture.

Provided by
: BigPicture

Before you start
: Say which service your question is about, what you tried, and any error message you saw.

How to get access
: Write to the Service Desk about:

  - logging in and joining your organisation: [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Perun](perun.qmd)
  - finding and applying for data: [Discovery](discovery.qmd), [REMS](rems.qmd)
  - uploading and downloading: [SlideTap](slidetap.qmd), [Data transporter](data-transporter.qmd), [Repository](repository.qmd)
  - the [metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd), data preparation and quality checks
  - becoming a contributing partner, collaboration and general questions
  - a data breach: report it straight away

Guides
: [None needed]{.proto-none}

Terms and privacy
: [BigPicture privacy notice](https://bigpicture.eu/bigpicture-privacy-notice)

Support
: ::: {.proto-help}
